items.title: What happens to your overall scope score as one dimension widens?
items.description: Each of the four dimensions from L1 — ambiguity tolerance, blast radius, time horizon, influence radius — can be rated narrow (1) to wide (10). Drag influence radius (the one Jordan was narrowest on early in L1's scenario) and watch how much the composite score moves versus the other three staying fixed at Alex's typical narrow-scope defaults.
items.compute: const scopeScore = Math.round(((params.ambiguityTolerance + params.blastRadius + params.timeHorizon + params.influenceRadius) / 40) * 100); return { scopeScore };
